overview.title: Program Overview
overview.description: PCI Health Training Center’s Medical Office Assistant Program prepares students for front office and administrative roles in healthcare by teaching EHR procedures, medical coding and billing, insurance processing, medical records management, collections, basic medical terminology, first aid and CPR, combining classroom instruction with hands-on computer lab exercises and a supervised externship.

items.description: Training on EHR use and simulated office workflows.

items.title: Medical coding and billing
items.description: Procedural codes for billing purposes and insurance claim processing.

items.description: Maintaining records, billing collections, and front office management procedures.

items.title: Basic medical terminology, first aid and CPR
items.description: Foundational clinical knowledge to support administrative duties.

items.title: Computer lab exercises and simulated office training
items.description: Practical hands-on exercises to apply administrative and EHR skills.

faq.question: How long does the Medical Office Assistant program take to complete?
faq.answer: The program can prepare you in as little as six months, consisting of 400 hours of classroom training plus a 200-hour externship.

faq.question: Where is the program offered?
faq.answer: PCI Health Training Center offers the Medical Office Assistant program at the Richardson campus (1300 International Parkway, Richardson, TX) and the Dallas campus (8101 John Carpenter Freeway, Dallas, TX).

faq.question: What kind of practical training is included?
faq.answer: The curriculum includes practical hands-on exercises in a computer lab, training in a simulated medical office environment, and a supervised 200-hour externship in a medical office, clinic, lab, or hospital.

faq.question: Is the program accredited?
faq.answer: Yes. PCI Health Training Center is accredited by the Accrediting Commission of Career Schools and Colleges (ACCSC) and is approved and regulated by the Texas Workforce Commission – TWC Career Schools and Colleges Section.
